cases.summary: Stable happy path: fill, submit, read confirmation; no recovery, no console errors.
Button renamed Place order to Submit order with identical role and behavior; resolver recovery must stay visible.
Two identical Place order controls; the observed match count drives the locator policy to ambiguous with no click attempted.
Full-page overlay dismisses after 3000ms; execution recovery must stay visible.
Same happy-path bytes served after a 1500ms delay; short-timeout failure then bounded retry must stay visible.
Flow completes visually but console.error fires on load; console oracle must gate, never clean-pass.
Unguarded form submits twice on double click; submit count 2 must surface as a defect.
Checkout review step removed; SEMANTIC_DRIFT_DETECTED must surface and block ordinary PASS.
Evidence assembly across mismatched source identities must throw visibly; zero leakage.
Password entry completes login; Ascout-owned evidence must contain zero raw secrets.
